goal: Minimize idle CPU, wakeups and memory while preserving native ad hiding and guarded Qt6 full-height layout.
constraints: Preserve the existing resource lifetime and discovery polling fixes.
Keep classic native ad hiding functional without Node/Frida.
Use portable optional runtime paths and GUI-thread Qt property changes.
Do not change KakaoTalk files, user data or system network configuration.
decisions: Recognize owned Qt6 ad windows and the AdFit NAS Advertisement title.
Remove clipping and frame modifications from the Qt6 ad-hiding path.
Exclude the verified AdBanner loader and separator from ColumnLayout.
Bundle or explicitly select Node and Frida; no REA/Codex installation is required.
Validate x64, Qt 6.10.3 and the component hierarchy before layout changes.
Coalesce relevant window events for 50 ms, retain 30-second health discovery and a 2-second fallback when hook registration fails.
Only start the optional Qt helper for discovered Qt PIDs and send target updates over parent-owned stdin.
Use bounded startup retries and temporary GUI hooks instead of permanent timers/DispatchMessage interception; bound metadata and deduplicate status writes.
Allow ignored runtime/paths.json for shared local runtimes, with environment overrides taking precedence.
verified_results: The local prototype expanded the content area to the full window height and moved the lower sidebar icons down.
The local prototype preserved the native frame and unchanged KakaoTalk process/executable.
The local prototype cleaned up its old helper and reapplied the layout after blocker restart.
go test ./... passed, including runtime discovery and existing resource regression tests.
Windows amd64, 386 and arm64 builds passed.
JavaScript syntax checks passed for the agent, helper and runtime packaging script.
The pinned runtime installed with npm ci and the packaging script produced a portable Windows x64 Node/Frida runtime.
The bundled runtime loaded Frida and resolved the running KakaoTalk executable path with NODE_PATH cleared.
2026-10-23: Go tests and Windows amd64/386/arm64 builds passed after resource optimization.
Real WinEvent delivery, cancellation/unhook and lazy helper startup checks passed.
Fake-device helper tests passed for idle scheduling, target recreation and EOF restore/unload/detach.
Classic KakaoTalk 26.9.0.5337: live content resize corrected within 77 ms while preserving main frame/region, app PID and startup path.
Installed blocker plus helper idle CPU changed from 5.5003% to 0.0520% of one core; private memory from 163.83 to 49.00 MiB; no helper runs with classic KakaoTalk.
limitations: Live layout verification covers KakaoTalk 26.9.0.420 with Qt 6.10.3 on Windows x64.
Qt6 is no longer installed on the resource-test host. New scheduling was tested with a fake device; the prior live Qt layout result is historical.
Measured improvement includes bringing existing fork resource fixes into the older local installation.

measurements.scope: Local installed legacy build versus optimized build, classic KakaoTalk open. Short normalized idle samples; no battery-runtime or long-duration leak claim.
